<thought>Search the template catalog for a retrosynthetic template that breaks an aldehyde and an aliphatic carboxylic acid and forms a C‑C double bond, which corresponds to the Doebner modification (aldehyde + malonic acid → α,β‑unsaturated acid). Use a simple cinnamic acid as the target molecule.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "c1ccc(C=CC(=O)O)cc1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aldehydes", "aliphatic carboxylic acid"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["C-C double bonds"]
}</action_input>
